question: By what agency alone can the determination of the Kaula teaching become known to the speaker?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
Knowledge of the Kaula determination arises only by grace.
Through that grace, the speaker has come to know it.
inference: It is only by the grace of the lord of the Kaulas that the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The extent of what has been known is left unspecified.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
